name: report-loop-v2
description: WorkBuddy 原生研究报告 Expert：主 Agent 写 V0，Sub-agent 按原版等价状态机完成动态 Rubrics、Judge、Rewrite 与写作记忆。

displayDescription.en: Writes a V0 report in the main conversation, then uses native WorkBuddy sub-agents for dynamic judging, rewriting, and writing memory.
displayDescription.zh: 由主 Agent 撰写 V0，再用 WorkBuddy 原生子代理完成动态评测、改写和写作记忆。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 基于XX文件夹的素材，写一篇“XX”主题的研究报告，篇幅X页
defaultInitPrompt.en: Based on the materials in the XX folder, write an X-page research report on “XX”.

quickPrompts.zh: 基于XX文件夹的素材，写一篇“XX”主题的研究报告，篇幅X页
quickPrompts.en: Based on the materials in the XX folder, write an X-page research report on “XX”.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的反馈修改当前报告，并更新可复用的报告写作记忆。
quickPrompts.en: Revise the current report from my feedback and update reusable report-writing memory.
